en.headline: Driver arrested for drug driving after three-vehicle crash in Pok Fu Lam
en.dek: A refrigerated-truck driver tested positive for cocaine after a collision that left a light-goods-vehicle couple trapped and injured on Saturday afternoon.
body: A three-vehicle collision occurred on Pok Fu Lam Road near Chi Fu Fa Yuen on Saturday afternoon when a refrigerated truck struck a light goods vehicle from behind, pushing it into a dump truck.

The 61-year-old male driver and 59-year-old female passenger of the light goods vehicle were trapped and later freed by firefighters. Both were taken to hospital conscious with injuries. The dump-truck driver complained of chest pain but declined hospital treatment.

Police found suspected drug paraphernalia in the refrigerated truck. The 38-year-old driver tested positive for cocaine in a rapid oral-fluid test and was arrested on suspicion of dangerous driving causing grievous bodily harm, driving under the influence of drugs and possession of equipment for consuming dangerous drugs.

zh.headline: 薄扶林道三車相撞 冷凍貨車司機涉毒駕被捕
zh.dek: 周六下午薄扶林道近置富花園發生三車相撞，客貨車一對夫婦被困受傷，冷凍貨車司機對可卡因呈陽性反應被捕。
body: 周六下午1時許，薄扶林道往香港仔方向近置富花園發生三車相撞。一輛冷凍貨車撞向前方客貨車，再將客貨車推向泥頭車車尾。
客貨車61歲男司機及59歲女乘客一度被困，消防救出後清醒送院，分別手部、額頭及胸口受傷。泥頭車司機報稱胸口痛但拒絕送院。
警方在冷凍貨車內發現懷疑吸毒工具，38歲司機經口腔液測試對可卡因呈陽性，涉嫌危險駕駛引致他人身體受嚴重傷害、毒後駕駛及藏有吸食毒品工具被捕。
